purpose: Frozen provenance registry separating FireSense training evidence, independent external comparison evidence, rejected same-campaign evidence, and unresolved validation leads.

sources.title: Effect of oxygen concentration, pressure, and opposed flow velocity on the flame spread along thin PMMA sheets
blocking_reasons: The closest normoxic microgravity condition uses 100 mm/s rather than the FireSense 50 mm/s reference.
Normal-gravity transport is not directly equivalent to the FireSense reference.
Operational flame-front measurement definitions differ without empirical cross-calibration.

sources.title: SDSU narrow-channel PMMA flame-spread experiments
blocking_reasons: Uses simulated rather than true microgravity.
Reported PMMA thicknesses do not match the 200 um target.

sources.title: MiniTexus 6 thin-PMMA microgravity flame-spread evidence
blocking_reasons: Available true-microgravity conditions use approximately 40 percent oxygen rather than the 21 percent FireSense target.

sources.title: Independent PMMA flame-spread study reported in 2025
blocking_reasons: Uses PMMA rods rather than the FireSense thin-sheet geometry family.
Reported dimensions do not match the 200 um sheet target.

sources.title: BASS-II PMMA flame-spread publication
blocking_reasons: Evidence comes from the BASS-II campaign already represented by FireSense training evidence.

sources.title: Thin PMMA flame spread in 4.5 s Gifu drop-tower microgravity
blocking_reasons: Exact 200 um, 21 percent O2, 1 atm and 50 mm/s condition has not been verified.
Numeric run-level values and replicate independence require primary-source verification.

unknown_source_policy.reason: An unknown source must be reviewed before it can be treated as independent validation evidence.

guardrails: Source independence is established by provenance review, not by a request payload boolean.
A source may be independent while still being incompatible with the FireSense validation target.
Same-campaign BASS-II evidence cannot satisfy independent external validation.
Unknown sources fail closed until scientific provenance review.
